roleHint.full_access: Manage the project, its members, approve and edit expenses.
roleHint.authorize: Approve or reject expenses, but cannot create them.
roleHint.modify: Create and edit expenses and budget items, but cannot approve.
roleHint.read_only: View data and run reports only.

companies.title: Organisations
companies.description: Step 1 — every project and user belongs to an organisation.
companies.formHint: Branches sit under a parent organisation, but access never cascades down the tree.
companies.name: Name
companies.codeHint: Short unique code, e.g. SSS or PSG
companies.codeAutoHint: Leave blank and one is generated from the name.
companies.parentHint: For grouping and reporting only; it does not grant access.
companies.trialHint: Leave blank for the default 45-day trial.
companies.deleteMessage: "{name}" will be removed. Only empty organisations can be deleted.

projects.title: Projects
projects.formHint: The project's organisation is fixed once created.
projects.name: Name
projects.codeHint: Unique within the organisation, e.g. SOLAR-3MW
projects.companyLocked: Cannot be moved to another organisation.
projects.emptyInCompany: This organisation has no projects yet
projects.deleteMessage: "{name}" will be removed. Projects with expenses cannot be deleted.

categories.title: Expense categories
categories.description: Shared across every project — these fill the category picker on expenses and split the reports.
categories.formHint: Sub-categories go one level deep. Retire an old category by turning off "Active" rather than deleting it.
categories.name: Category
categories.codeHint: Short unique code, e.g. EQUIPMENT or FUEL
categories.parentHint: Groups categories in reports, e.g. "Documents" over "EDL" and "Fees".
categories.colorHint: Used for this category in report charts — #RRGGBB
categories.sortOrderHint: Lower numbers come first. Ties are sorted by name.
categories.isActiveHint: Active — when off it disappears from the picker on new expenses, but existing entries stay in this category
categories.inUseHint: Cannot delete — {count} expenses are in this category. Turn off "Active" instead.
categories.hasChildrenHint: Cannot delete — this category still has sub-categories
categories.deleteMessage: "{name}" will be permanently removed. It can be deleted because no expense references it.

payers.title: Payers
payers.description: Funding sources — who put the money up. Shared across every project, used by both expenses and revenue.
payers.formHint: Names must be unique — that is what stops "SSS" and "SSS " becoming two separate rows.
payers.name: Name
payers.nameHint: Leading and trailing spaces are trimmed automatically
payers.isActiveHint: Active — when off it disappears from the picker on new entries, but existing ones still reference it
payers.inUseHint: Cannot delete — {count} entries reference this payer. Turn off "Active" instead.
payers.deleteMessage: "{name}" will be permanently removed. It can be deleted because no entry references it.

payees.title: Payees
payees.description: Shops, individuals or government bodies that received money from an expense.
payees.formHint: Bank account numbers are stored encrypted — only the last 4 digits are ever shown again.
payees.name: Name
payees.bankAccountHint: Stored encrypted; only the last 4 digits are shown again
payees.bankAccountKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the current number. Type a new one to replace it.
payees.isActiveHint: Active — when off it disappears from the picker on new expenses, but existing ones still reference it
payees.inUseHint: Cannot delete — {count} expenses were paid to this payee. Turn off "Active" instead.
payees.truncated: Showing {shown} of {total} — use the search box to narrow it down
payees.deleteMessage: "{name}" will be permanently removed. It can be deleted because no expense references it.

banks.title: Banks
banks.description: The banks used on transfer slips and payee accounts. Shared across every project.
banks.formHint: The code is forced to upper case so "bcel" and "BCEL" can never become two banks.
banks.codeHint: Short code people actually use, e.g. BCEL, LDB, JDB
banks.name: Name
banks.shortNameHint: Shown where the full name will not fit
banks.logoHint: JPG, PNG or WEBP up to 4 MB. Re-encoded to WebP and scaled down to 256 px.
banks.inUseHint: Cannot delete — {count} entries record a transfer through this bank. Turn off "Active" instead.
banks.sortOrderHint: Lower numbers come first in lists
banks.isActiveHint: Active — when off it disappears from pickers, but rows that already reference it keep working
banks.deleteMessage: "{name}" and its logo will be permanently removed.

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.description: The currencies entries can be recorded in. "Decimals" defines what every stored amount means, so it is set once at creation and locked after that.
currencies.createHint: Code and decimals are set once — neither can be changed after saving.
currencies.editHint: Only the names, symbol, order and status can be changed.
currencies.codeHint: Three letters, ISO-4217 — e.g. LAK, THB, USD
currencies.codeLocked: Locked — five tables reference this code
currencies.name: Name
currencies.decimalsLocked: Locked — this value defines what every stored amount means
currencies.isActiveHint: Active — when off it disappears from the picker on new entries, but existing ones still reference it
currencies.sortOrderHint: Lower numbers appear first in pickers
currencies.coreHint: Cannot delete {code} — it is a core currency every conversion runs through
currencies.inUseHint: Cannot delete — {count} records reference this currency. Turn off "Active" instead.
currencies.deleteMessage: "{code}" will be permanently removed. It can be deleted because no entry or exchange rate references it.

rates.title: Exchange rates
rates.description: Reference rates, set in kip like the BCEL board: 1 USD = ? LAK and 1 THB = ? LAK. Every entry snapshots its own rate when saved, so editing a rate here never moves an amount already recorded.
rates.empty: No exchange rates yet — set the first one before any non-USD entry can be recorded
rates.formHint: The rate is how many kip make 1 unit of that currency. Set USD first: the THB rate is checked against it. One rate per currency per day.
rates.effectiveDateHint: Entries from this date onward use this rate, until a newer date is set
rates.rateLakHint: How many kip make 1 {code} — e.g. 22239 for USD, 675.48 for THB
rates.truncated: Showing {shown} of {total} — narrow the date range to see fewer

credentials.title: System accounts
credentials.description: Usernames and passwords for the systems this organisation uses. Visible to platform admins only, and revealing a password always asks for your own password first.
credentials.formHint: Passwords are encrypted at rest and are never sent out with the list.
credentials.titleHint: System or account name, e.g. "LBB App Account"
credentials.urlLinkHint: A web address, or where it is used, e.g. "MOBILE APP"
credentials.passwordEditHint: Leave blank to keep the current password
credentials.isActiveHint: Active — inactive accounts are hidden from the list
credentials.revealHint: Enter your own password to reveal the password for "{name}". Every reveal is recorded.
credentials.deleteMessage: "{name}" and its password will be deleted permanently and cannot be recovered.

users.title: Users
users.description: Step 3 — create accounts, then assign them to projects from the Projects page.
users.formHint: Expiry comes from the organisation; a per-account date can only cut it shorter.
users.name: Name
users.passwordEditHint: Leave blank to keep the current password.
users.companyHint: The organisation's plan controls when this user's access ends.
users.isPlatformAdminHint: Manages organisations and users. Never expires.
users.expiresAtHint: Leave blank to follow the organisation only.
users.companyExpiry: Organisation expires {date} — access ends on whichever date comes first.
users.beyondCompanyExpiry: The organisation expires {date}. A later date here has no effect until the organisation is renewed.
users.deleteMessage: "{name}" will be removed. Users assigned to projects cannot be deleted.

members.title: Project access
members.noneAssignable: Everyone in this organisation already has access.
members.noUsersYet: This organisation has no users yet — create an account before granting access.

audit.title: Audit logs
audit.heading: System activity
audit.description: Sign-ins, searches and every create/update/delete — newest first. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.
audit.subject: Record
audit.searchHint: Name, email, document no. or IP
audit.noChanges: This event has no additional data.
audit.truncated: More than {cap} entries match — only the latest {cap} are shown. Narrow the date range or add filters.

profile.title: My profile
profile.name: Name
profile.projectsHint: Your access level decides what you can do in each project.
profile.noProjects: You are not a member of any project yet. Ask a project owner to add you.

avatar.hint: JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to 8 MB
avatar.badType: Only JPG, PNG and WEBP are supported
avatar.tooLarge: The photo is larger than 8 MB

approvals.title: Awaiting approval
approvals.heading: Entries waiting for your decision
approvals.description: Everything submitted for approval across the projects you authorise, newest first.
approvals.empty: Nothing is waiting for your approval.

tx.selectProjectFirst: Select a project to view its transactions
tx.notAMember: You are not a member of this project
tx.notAMemberHint: Financial records are only visible to project members — being a platform administrator is not enough. Go to Settings → Projects → Members and assign yourself an access level ("Full access" or "Modify" to record entries).
tx.title: Description
tx.confirmUnusualRate: I confirm this rate is correct (even though it is unusual)
tx.bankReceivedHint: Which bank account the money landed in — match the slip you attach
tx.dropHint: or drag them here — JPG, PNG, WEBP or PDF, up to 12 MB each
tx.deleteMessage: {entry} will be removed from the project. You cannot restore it yourself.
tx.noEvidence: No evidence attached to this entry
tx.evidenceKindHint: Pick the type first — it is stored with the files you drop next
tx.evidenceQueued: {count} file(s) waiting — they upload as soon as you save this entry
tx.evidenceAfterSave: Save this entry first, then you can attach evidence photos.
tx.evidenceLocked: This entry is approved — its evidence is locked.

workflow.submitHint: Send this entry to an approver for review
workflow.approveHint: Sign this entry off — it can no longer be edited afterwards
workflow.approveWarning: Approving locks the entry — it can no longer be edited or deleted. Only a system administrator can cancel the approval and send it back for correction.
workflow.reopenHint: Cancel the approval and send it back to the author to correct (e.g. the exchange rate)
workflow.reopenWarning: The entry leaves the reports and becomes Rejected. The author can edit it (amount, rate) and submit it again, and it needs a fresh approval. This is recorded in the audit log.
workflow.rejectHint: Send it back to the author for correction
workflow.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. no transfer slip attached / amount does not match the receipt
workflow.reasonHint: The author sees this reason and works from it (at least 3 characters)

revenues.title: Revenue
revenues.formHint: Amounts are converted to USD using the rate recorded here.

expenses.title: Expense
expenses.description: Money paid out of the project.
expenses.formHint: Amounts are converted to USD using the rate recorded here.

ledger.title: General Ledger
ledger.selectProjectFirst: Select a project to view its ledger
ledger.noBudget: No budget set for this project
ledger.budgetOtherCurrency: Budget is set in {currency} — it has no recorded exchange rate, so it cannot be shown in LAK
ledger.lakNote: Amount columns and totals are shown in LAK, converted at the exchange rate recorded on each entry. The USD figure under each title is for reference.

reports.printHint: Opens the PDF in a new tab to preview first; save or print it from there. It contains exactly the rows the filters above return — the same figures you see on screen.
reports.lakCaption: Converted at the rate recorded on each entry
reports.payerCaption: Payers with entries in this period
reports.missingEvidenceCaption: Entries with no slip or receipt attached
reports.tooManyHint: These filters return {rows} entries, over the limit of {max} per report. Narrow the date range or pick a payer and try again.

revenues.title: Revenue report
revenues.sourceCaption: Sources with entries in this period

ledger.title: Revenue & expense report
ledger.monthlyHint: Computed from the same rows as the detail below, so each month's closing balance always matches that month's last entry.

accessExpired.body: {company} can no longer use the system.
